title: Multi-Unit Plan Case Study - 814 Issues Found
summary: New case study: AI review of multi-unit townhome project found 814 issues across 8 disciplines (Fire, Structural, Architectural, Mechanical, Plumbing, Electrical, Accessibility, Civil). 47 critical issues, 298 high severity. Demonstrates AI's ability to catch cross-discipline coordination issues at scale.
